How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Sent · Just now

SweetBot · AI says:

To get the best results from our products, please:

Set up and let memory foam expand: Unpack immediately, place flat, and allow 24–72 hours to fully expand. A warmer room and gently lying/rolling on it can speed expansion.

Sleep position & firmness: Memory foam conforms to your body for support and pressure relief whether you sleep on your back, side, or stomach.

Layer benefits: Multiple foam layers work together—top for comfort, deeper layers for support—so use the mattress flat on a solid, compatible base.

Daily use: Sleep on it regularly for several days to a few weeks so the foam can adjust to your body and feel more comfortable over time.

Care & maintenance:

Use a mattress protector to guard against spills and dirt.
Vacuum the surface periodically.
Rotate the mattress 180° every few months; if double‑sided, you may also flip it.
Avoid direct sunlight and high heat to protect the materials and extend lifespan.

In‑home trial: Use the full in‑home trial period in your normal sleep environment so you can evaluate long‑term comfort. If, after the adjustment period, it still doesn’t meet your needs, you may return it with no hidden fees or restocking charges.

Following these steps helps you use the mattress correctly, maximize comfort, and extend its life.
